import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import multiclass_log_loss
from pathlib import Path

# Suppress tqdm progress bars
from sklearn.utils import check_random_state

check_random_state(42)  # Initialize random state if needed

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

# Load sample submission to determine expected column structure
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH)
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_sub.shape}")
print(f"Columns: {list(sample_sub.columns)}")

# Load training data
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
print(f"Training data shape: {train_df.shape}")

# Load test data
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
print(f"Test data shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Identify feature columns and target column
features_columns = [col for col in train_df.columns if col != "id" and col != "species"]
target_col = "species"

X_train = train_df[features_columns].values
y_train = train_df[target_col].values
X_test = test_df[features_columns].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Split training data for validation
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, stratify=y_train, random_state=42
)

# Initialize and train Random Forest Classifier
rf_model = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=200, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
rf_model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Validate on held-out set (never seen by training)
y_val_pred = rf_model.predict_proba(X_val)
val_metric = multiclass_log_loss(
    y_val, y_val_pred, labels=list(train_df[target_col].unique())
)
print(f"\nValidation Log-Loss Score: {val_metric:.4f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
y_test_pred = rf_model.predict_proba(X_test)

# Prepare submission dataframe
submission_data = []
species_order = list(train_df[target_col].unique())

for i, row_id in enumerate(test_ids):
    predictions_row = {}
    predictions_row["id"] = int(row_id)
    for j, species in enumerate(species_order):
        predictions_row[species] = float(round(y_test_pred[i][j], 6))
    submission_data.append(predictions_row)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(submission_data)
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {SUBMISSION_PATH}")
print(f"Final validation metric: {val_metric:.4f}")
